answer: An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the glacier index resolves every citation against the zenith checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the quill audit keeps the resolved set. Each duplicate costs another 187 dollars in locked collateral and another 10 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
